name_zh: 老挝·苏发努冯：红王子中立与三王子联合
name_en: Laos Souphanouvong: Red Prince Neutrality & Three Princes Unity
description_zh: 苏发努冯 (1909-1995) 老挝红王子，巴特寮领袖，1957/1962/1973三次联合政府，坚持中立外交在美苏中三大阵营夹缝生存，1975年胜利任主席推动民族和解。
description_en: Souphanouvong (1909-1995) Laos Red Prince, Pathet Lao leader, 1957/1962/1973 three coalition governments, insisted neutral diplomacy surviving in US-Soviet-China three camps squeeze, 1975 victory became President promoted national reconciliation.
reason_zh: 苏发努冯代表冷战夹缝小国通过中立外交与王室身份实现共产主义革命与民族和解的双重奇迹，展示了红色王子如何转化阶级矛盾为民族团结。
reason_en: Souphanouvong represents Cold War squeeze small state achieving communist revolution and national reconciliation dual miracle through neutral diplomacy and royal identity, demonstrating how Red Prince transformed class contradiction into national unity.
steps_zh: 研究苏发努冯王子身份与越南革命洗礼
分析1950年巴特寮成立与武装斗争
探讨三次联合政府(1957/1962/1973)权力分享机制
评估1975年胜利主席任内民族和解与经济建设
总结红王子中立三王子联合对老挝生存智慧的贡献
steps_en: Study Souphanouvong prince identity and Vietnam revolutionary baptism
Analyze 1950 Pathet Lao founding and armed struggle
Explore three coalition governments (1957/1962/1973) power sharing mechanism
Evaluate 1975 victory President term national reconciliation and economic construction
Summarize Red Prince neutrality three princes unity contribution to Laos survival wisdom
expected_zh: 理解王室身份如何为共产革命提供合法性保护，掌握中立外交在大国夹缝中生存空间拓展逻辑，评估三王子联合模式对分裂社会愈合的普遍启示。
expected_en: Understand how royal identity provides legitimacy protection for communist revolution, grasp neutral diplomacy survival space expansion logic in great power squeeze, evaluate three princes unity model universal lessons for divided society healing.
case_zh: 1909 王子出生；1950 巴特寮；1957/62/73 联合；1975 胜利主席。红王子中立三王子联合范式永存。
case_en: 1909 prince birth; 1950 Pathet Lao; 1957/62/73 coalitions; 1975 victory President. Red Prince neutrality three princes unity paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Royal communist leader; neutral diplomacy; coalition government; national reconciliation
